title: デビュー戦の後に・1本の電話

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo returns from her debut race exhausted and out of breath, but overjoyed to now be able to race professionally.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The mood is soon dampened when she receives a phone call from her disapproving mother. Judging by the tense conversation, it's clear a deep discord rests between them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But her mother's words do not sway King's resolve to prove her wrong. Determined, she declares her intent to win the G1 Hopeful Stakes.
